---
title: "Sequential models"
---

Sequential models make predictions from ordered observations. The first
explorer starts from the simplest case: predicting one future value from a
fixed window of its own past values.

## 1. Autoregressive models

Use real hourly transformer oil-temperature measurements to see what changes
when an autoregressive model is allowed to look back one hour, several hours,
one day, or one week.

[Explore autoregressive model order](01-autoregressive-models-explorer.qmd)
